name: Ginga Ojou-sama Densetsu Yuna 3: Lightning Angel
original_name: 銀河お嬢様伝説ユナ3 LIGHTNING ANGEL
source:
The Machine Empress plants a bomb that while surely destroy the Earth. Its up to Yuna and gang to stop her and bring peace to the earth. But soon they will find out theres more to the Machine Empress and her army than her motives of destroying Earth....

[From [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/saturn/580969-ginga-ojousama-densetsu-yuna-3-lightning-angel/faqs/33421]gamefaqs[/url]]
translation:
机器女皇放置了一颗炸弹，这肯定会摧毁地球。尤娜和她的帮派有责任阻止她，为地球带来和平。但很快他们就会发现机器女皇和她的军队不仅仅是毁灭地球的动机……

[来自[url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/saturn/580969-ginga-ojousama-densetsu-yuna-3-lightning-angel/faqs/33421]gamefaqs[/url]]
